description: This file contains functions and types related to checking and formatting update status information for a software project, including version comparison, update availability, and update messages.

methods.name: getUpdateCheckResult
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the update check result based on provided parameters.

methods.name: resolveUpdateAvailability
methods.description: Determines update availability details from the update check result.

methods.name: formatUpdateAvailableHint
methods.description: Formats a user-friendly message indicating if an update is available.

methods.name: formatUpdateOneLiner
methods.description: Creates a concise string summarizing the update status.
